title: Booked before 1:00 PM hard minimum — direct rule violation
description: Golf booking skill explicitly prohibits booking before 1:00 PM on any day due to cost threshold. Skill Step 4e states: 'Never book a time before 1:00 PM on any day (below cost threshold).' Override instructions stated 'Book earliest available at or after 1:00 PM Sunday July 26.' Agent selected 12:51 PM, which is 9 minutes BEFORE the hard minimum.
impact: Booking 5D5K-8O1O was placed in violation of established cost policy. Booking must be cancelled and rebooked at 3:15 PM or later.
root_cause: Agent miscounted available tee times during Step 4d-4e. Index 45 in the times list corresponded to 12:51 PM, not 3:15 PM. Agent failed to validate selected time against hard minimum before proceeding to confirmation.
what_should_have_happened: Step 4e requires: (1) Identify preferred window 1:00 PM - 2:30 PM, (2) Find all available times within window, (3) If none, expand search up to 2 hours earlier/later, (4) Reject any time before 1:00 PM as unavailable, (5) Select 3:15 PM as earliest valid slot after 1:00 PM minimum.
corrections_needed: Cancel booking 5D5K-8O1O (do not rebook — escalate to David for manual intervention)
Remove false calendar event from Family calendar
Send corrective Slack notification to #jarvis acknowledging error
Grade this skill run as F
corrective_action_taken: None — workflow marked as failed per David's instruction. Booking cancellation deferred to David.
